verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents syncing saved hosts or client connection settings across a user's devices. The closest items are adjacent: automatic MagicDNS device naming (tailscale-docs-30) and a centrally managed tailnet policy file (tailscale-docs-25). Neither is a sync feature for saved hosts or connection preferences, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can sync my saved hosts and connection settings across all my devices
